notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (free credits used). Initial integration done by frontend engineer on 2026-02-27.

Summary of problem: Elmbridge is building a streaming chat assistant that also triggers backend tools (inventory_lookup, create_ticket). They configured function schemas and function-calling in the request but see frequent JSON.parse errors in their Node streaming handler. Symptoms: partial JSON chunks in streaming events, function call name in schema (create_ticket) occasionally comes through as 'CreateTicket' (case mismatch), and schema validation fails on args (missing required fields) when the SDK attempts to deliver a parsed object.

Important snippets from customer: "We get 'Unexpected token' when JSON.parse in onData for a subset of messages — other times it works; it's flaky." Also: "We thought streaming would give us final function_call payloads per event, but we get split fragments and our parser fails."

What they've tried: - switched between JSON.stringify+manual parse and Redwood Node SDK streaming helpers (still flaky)
- simplified function schema to flat parameters (reduced nested objects) -> reduced frequency of errors but not resolved
- tested with both 'gpt-4o-mini' and an open Llama variant on hosted -> same behavior
- attempted client-side buffering (concat chunks until closing brace) but hard to detect end reliably when model streams incremental tokens.

Account context: small engineering team, self-serve sign-up, low initial traffic but plan pilot with 500 daily sessions. Cost sensitivity high for first 3 months. No dedicated procurement yet. SSO planned but not enforced for PoC.

Recommended notes from AE/SE: - schedule 30-min debug session to reproduce with their Node streaming handler (SE: Maya Lopez). Bring sample stream logs and the exact function schema. - ask customer to enable structured_output/json_mode flag and attach the function schema exactly as sent to model (preserve name-case). - recommend using server-side aggregator that collects stream tokens until a full function_call object is emitted (look for the SDK 'function_call' end event, or use Redwood SDK streaming JSON helper). - suggest setting 'response_format' or 'json_schema' with top-level object shape to reduce ambiguous tokenization; flatten deeply nested required params during initial POC. - validate that client and function schema names are case-exact; prefer snake_case for stable mapping. - if they want immediate workaround: use non-streaming call for function/invocation until streaming parsing is stable.

Open items / next actions: - Elmbridge to drop a sanitized stream trace into Drive link (above) before 2026-03-12. - AE to book Maya + Elmbridge engineering for 30m on 2026-03-15. - SE to prepare a tiny Node test harness (will share repo link) that demonstrates buffering + parse helper. - Security: Elmbridge asks about audit logs and SSO timeline; confirm hosted has audit events and SAML available in paid tier.

Sales tone / signals: curious about Dedicated later if latency and reliability tradeoffs justify cost. For now, heavy preference for hosted_api and low-friction onboarding.
